title: Coordinates of a root-cube vector are nonzero
statement: Let $K$ be a field and let $\omega \in K$ with $\omega \neq 0$. If $x \in \{1,\omega\}^n$, that is, $x$ is a vector in $K^n$ each of whose coordinates equals either $1$ or $\omega$, then every coordinate is nonzero: $x_i \neq 0$ for each index $i$.
hypotheses_covered: x is a vector in the root cube {1,ω}^n (each coordinate is 1 or ω)
